Sam R: Hi team — just finished HR onboarding and Im blocked on two things: HubSpot seat still pending, and Dialpad app says "no license". Anyone know who to ping?

Talia (Sales Ops): @Sam R welcome! Send over your employee id and email. We usually provision HubSpot within 30 mins. Dialpad often follows once Telecom assigns a number.

Sam R: emp id RWF-2410; sam.r@redwood.ai. Thanks!

onboarding-bot: Welcome @Sam R! You've been added to #sales and assigned the Sales First-Week checklist. Please complete the security training link in your inbox.

Devon (IT): Hey Sam — I see a pending Telecom allocation for your email. I can push a temporary Dialpad license so you can test the app. If you want the shared SDR number, say so; otherwise open TELE-77 for a dedicated DID.

Sam R: Shared SDR number is fine for now. Temporary license would be great.

Talia (Sales Ops): OPS ticket OPS-3098 created for HubSpot/Gong + Dialpad temp license. Expect HubSpot invite from ops@redwood.ai and Gong from enablement.

Devon (IT): Pushed the temp license. Try signing into Dialpad desktop now. If you see a login failure, clear cache or try the web client: https://dialpad.redwood.example/login

Sam R: Web client works! I can see the app and voicemails. Thanks Devon.

Riya (Enablement): Welcome Sam!! :tada: Quick checklist for week 1: 1) Open SDR playbook (https://redwood.docs/sales/onboarding/sdr-week1) 2) Join shadow sessions with your buddy (Ben or Priya) 3) Complete call template practice. I'll drop templates below.

Riya (Enablement): ```
Cold intro script (30s):
"Hi, I'm Sam with Redwood Inference. We help infra teams reduce inference latency and cost. Quick question — who owns model serving at your org?"

Discovery prompt:
"Can you walk me through your current model deployment? GPUs, hosts, or managed provider?"
```

Sam R: Perfect — I'll review the playbook and join the shadow sessions. Any tips for tagging Gong recordings for coaching?

Riya (Enablement): Use tags #coaching or #demo. For anything that might contain PII, use #sensitive and ping legal. Retention: SDRs default 90 days. See the recording policy link in the docs.

Talia (Sales Ops): HubSpot invite just went out — check your inbox and junk. Once you accept, let us know and we'll map lead queues.

Sam R: Accepted HubSpot and I can see pipelines. Dialpad web is working too. Thanks all for the quick turnaround!

Devon (IT): Closing OPS-3098 as temporary license applied. File TELE-77 if you want a dedicated number.

Sam R: Will do later if needed. Appreciate the help :heart:

(END OF THREAD)
